Having made her presence known, Sakura 
Bakushin O rallies her spirits for the 
Classic Triple Crown route. However, it 
remains a steep mountain for her current 
self to climb.

Sensing this, the Trainer recommended she 
enter the Spring Stakes to buy time to 
consider their strategy going forward.

Given a convincing reason as a stepping 
stone toward challenging the Satsuki Sho, 
Sakura Bakushin O decided to enter the 
Spring Stakes.
